conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I got an overdraft facility on my account, and it’s a lifesaver! How do I increase the limit?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Glad it’s helping, sir! Can you confirm your account number for the request?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s seven eight, nine one, two three, four five, six eight. Can you make it quick?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’ll need your latest income proof to process the increase. Can you email it to us?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Sure thing. This bank’s been great, by the way!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Thank you, sir! Once we receive the documents, I’ll expedite the limit increase.
